title: REAR LOWER PANEL TO REAR UPPER PANEL & TRIM BRACKET
summary: Rear body: the rear lower panel (the panel under the four taillights, rear valance/rear end panel) is bonded to the rear upper panel with bonding strips (bond H), the tail pipe bezel flanges (exhaust outlet bezel mounts) are bonded at the lower rear corners (bond B, View A), and anchor nuts are riveted to the lower panel. On coupes (19437) an outer trim bracket is bonded below the rear window opening (View B).

parts.name: PANEL-BODY RR. LOWER
parts.name_expanded: Panel – body rear lower (rear end panel under the taillights)

parts.name: BRACKET-OUTER
parts.name_expanded: Bracket – outer trim bracket at rear window opening (LH/RH)

fastening.note: Bonding strip [1] backs the joint between the rear lower panel [2] and the upper panel above the taillights (bond H); bond H also along the lower edge at the quarter.

fastening.to: bracket at the lower edge of the rear lower panel [2], under the taillights
fastening.note: Rivets [3] go in from the rear through the bracket holes into anchor nut [4] behind it.
View A: tail pipe bezel flange [5] bonded with bond B at the lower outer corner of the rear panel.

fastening.to: body below the rear window opening
fastening.note: View B (19437 only): bracket [6] bonded with bond B, .86 below the opening edge and 15.07 outboard of the car centerline.

notes: View B (19437): .86; 15.07 to centerline of car
